column1: # Demos driven with real arguments and checked against something their output
# must contain. This is the layer that proves a demo still WORKS, as opposed to
# run-all-demos.sh, which only proves every demo still STARTS.
# Blank args means the demo takes none. A literal - as the expected string means
# "exit 0 is the whole check" (DumpIR writes files and prints nothing on success);
# an EMPTY expected string is rejected as an authoring error, so a case can never
#   %SQL%    a small generated query file, in a scratch directory
#   %OUT%    an empty scratch directory the demo may write into
#   %REPO%   the repository root, for the checked-in files under samples/
# Every expected string below was taken from that demo's actual output, not
# guessed. When a parser upgrade changes output legitimately, update the string
# here in the same commit that bumps gsp.core.version.
